The pepper seeds grilled with this seafood draw out its taste and pleasant aroma.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Pepper Seafoods by [[Cooking]] [[Spicy Pepper]]s with any type of seafood in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The default variation can only be made by using seafood that has contradictory effects to Spicy Peppers. When eaten, they will heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s. The seeds from the Peppers draw out the taste of this dish, in addition to providing a pleasant aroma. Only one variation of Pepper Seafoods can be made: * '''Spicy Pepper Seafood''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Pepper Seafood}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The pepper seeds grilled with this seafood draw out its taste and pleasant aroma.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hyrule Bass]]es, [[Sanke Carp]], or [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s. Eating these meals will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Pepper Steak * Sautéed Peppers }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
